summary: Tested 8 frontend features for Dubai International Exchange: Light/Dark mode toggle, Kurdish/Arabic/English language switching, Services section multi-language, Partners section with logos, Header navigation theme changes, and 3D elements. Found and fixed 1 bug in Kurdish partners section.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug in PartnersSection3D.js line 131 - Kurdish partners were showing Arabic names instead of Kurdish names
All 8 requested features are now working correctly
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 features tested and working: 1) Light/Dark mode toggle works correctly - uses both classList and data-theme attribute, 2) Kurdish language displays Kurdish text in navigation (سەرەکی, خزمەتگوزاریەکان, etc.), 3) Arabic language displays Arabic text correctly, 4) English language displays English text correctly with LTR direction, 5) Services section cards display correctly in all 3 languages with proper translations, 6) Partners section displays partner logos with correct names in each language (fixed Kurdish names bug), 7) Header navigation responds to theme changes (dark/light colors), 8) 3D elements load without JavaScript errors (canvas present).
tests_passed: Light/Dark mode toggle - classList and data-theme attribute both applied correctly
Dark mode: body background rgb(15, 23, 42), nav text rgb(203, 213, 225)
Light mode: body background rgb(248, 250, 252), nav text rgb(71, 85, 105)
Kurdish language - navigation shows: سەرەکی, خزمەتگوزاریەکان, هاوبەشەکان, بەدواداچوونی داواکاری, پەیوەندی
Kurdish language - CTA shows: دەست پێبکە
Kurdish language - document direction RTL, lang=ku
Arabic language - navigation shows: الرئيسية, الخدمات, الشركاء, تتبع الطلب, اتصل بنا
Arabic language - CTA shows: ابدأ الآن
Arabic language - document direction RTL, lang=ar
English language - navigation shows: Home, Services, Partners, Track Order, Contact
English language - CTA shows: Get Started
English language - document direction LTR, lang=en
Services section Arabic - 4 cards with Arabic titles and descriptions
Services section Kurdish - 4 cards with Kurdish titles and descriptions
Services section English - 4 cards with English titles and descriptions
Partners section Arabic - 6 partners with Arabic names
Partners section English - 6 partners with English names
Partners section Kurdish - 6 partners with Kurdish names (after fix)
3D Canvas element present on page
No JavaScript console errors
No JavaScript console warnings

light_dark_mode_toggle.details: Theme toggle correctly applies 'dark'/'light' class and data-theme attribute. Body background and nav text colors change appropriately.

kurdish_language.details: Kurdish language displays Kurdish text in navigation menu, CTA button, hero section, services section, and partners section. RTL direction applied.

arabic_language.details: Arabic language displays Arabic text correctly throughout the app. RTL direction applied.

english_language.details: English language displays English text correctly throughout the app. LTR direction applied.

services_section_multilang.details: All 4 service cards (USD Booking, Money Transfers, Card Top-up, USDT Recharge) display correctly in Arabic, Kurdish, and English.

partners_section.details: 6 partner logos displayed with correct names in each language. Fixed bug where Kurdish was showing Arabic names.

header_theme_changes.details: Header navigation text color changes appropriately: dark mode uses light text (slate-300), light mode uses dark text (slate-600).

3d_elements.details: 3D canvas element present, no JavaScript errors or warnings in console.

bug_fixed.issue: Kurdish partners were showing Arabic names instead of Kurdish names
bug_fixed.fix: Changed '{isArabic ? partner.nameAr : isKurdish ? partner.nameAr : partner.nameEn}' to '{isKurdish ? partner.nameKu : isArabic ? partner.nameAr : partner.nameEn}'
